meta.name: session-search
meta.description: Find context from past Claude Code (CLI) and Claude Cowork (desktop) sessions on this Mac. Use when the user wants to recall something they did before but can't find it , phrasings like "where did I work on X", "find that session where I…", "when did I last do Y", "pull up the conversation about Z", "that time I built/tried/discussed …". Searches by kind (code/cowork), time range, title, working directory, or free-text content across all transcripts.

copy.tagline: 从过往终端会话中找回任何操作记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在终端工作，想快速找回之前做过的操作或对话。
